newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN truck unit sees lower profit in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: MAN truck unit sees lower profit in 96/97.

text.p: MAN Nutzfahrzeuge AG, the truck making unit of MAN AG, said on Thursday it expects a lower but satisfactory profit in the 1996/97 business year due due to weak truck demand in Europe.
The company, Germany's second largest truck maker behind Mercedes-Benz, said it also expected a fall in output during 1996/97.
MAN Nutzfahrzeuge sales in 1995/96 which ended in June rose 10 percent to eight billion marks and pre-tax profits were up 24 percent to 50 million marks.
The truck maker accounts for about 40 percent of MAN AG's annual revenues.
MAN, like other truck makers, has been hurt by weak demand for heavy commerical vehicles throughout Europe and especially in Germany.
In September, MAN said it expected its truck business to improve in the second half of the 1996/97 year.
